trust_center.repositoryDescription: Linear’s Trust Center is available at trust.linear.app and hosts all our latest security and compliance resources.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: The Trust Center landing page and public documents are available without authentication. Restricted documents (e.g., SOC 2 Type II report, penetration test summaries, FedRAMP Certification Data marked non-public) can be requested via the **Request access** button on [https://trust.linear.app](https://trust.linear.app).

certified_services.serviceDescription:
Linear provides cloud hosted issue tracking and project management software for teams building software products and services. The app allows teams to triage and track bugs, plan project roadmaps, and continuously monitor progress through software development cycles. Linear is a common space for teams to work on their projects and interact with other teams through work assignments.

Linear integrates with other tools such as GitHub (code version control), Figma (design) and Zendesk (customer support) to streamline workflows. New bugs and tasks can be created from the application, or other integrated services such as Slack.

Linear is provided as a web service at [https://linear.app](https://linear.app). Users are also able to download desktop and mobile versions of the application.

current.service_desc:
Linear is the product development system for teams and agents, purpose-built for planning and building software products. It is a multi-tenant SaaS offering that provides issue tracking, project and cycle planning, roadmaps and initiatives, product intelligence, and agent workflows, delivered through web, desktop, and mobile clients and a public GraphQL API.

Linear is currently listed in the **Initial Implementation** phase and is pursuing a FedRAMP 20x certification for its existing commercial offering, starting with a Class A submission and progressing toward Class C. Linear does not operate a separate government-only environment.

**Certification scope.** The cloud service offering is the production Linear service. Federal customer data is stored and processed in Linear's US workspace region on Google Cloud Platform, with Cloudflare at the network edge. The offering includes these groups of information resources:

- **Edge (Cloudflare global network):** DNS, CDN, web application firewall and DDoS protection, and Workers for request routing, file delivery and the MCP server.
- **US workspace region (GCP us-east1, us-central1):** application, sync and background services on GKE, workspace databases, caches and queues, file storage, analytics, encryption keys, egress, and backups.
- **Shared control plane (GCP us-east1):** authentication and account services and the account database, shared by all workspace regions.
- **Build and deploy (GCP us-east1):** Cloud Build and Artifact Registry, with source code in GitHub.
- **Administrative access:** Google Workspace single sign-on and Cloudflare Access for staff access to production and support tooling.
- **Third-party information resources:** listed below with their use cases.

The logical architecture diagram in the Trust Center shows these groups and how requests move between them.

Progress toward certification is published at least quarterly in Linear’s Trust Center (https://trust.linear.app).
